text: The manual says RTH altitude is tied to the Home Point and should be higher than any obstacle in the area. It also states that obstacles on either side cannot be detected or avoided during RTH, and that the aircraft cannot avoid obstacles during failsafe RTH when there is insufficient light. The aircraft decelerates when an obstacle is sensed about 20 meters ahead, and it continues flying to the Home Point at its current altitude.
